description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1717/26 of 04.05.2011, Homagama D/S Division and other amendments
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically modifying parcel numbers, land extents, village designations, and mortgage particulars for various land parcels. The content is entirely focused on land and property-related matters, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4). There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land administrative matters present.
